feature_flags.how: add an `experimental_<name>: bool` field to CommonOptions, default it to false in the Default impl, and gate the new path on it. Existing examples: experimental_enable_vqueues, experimental_kafka_batch_ingestion, experimental_shuffler_batch_ingestion.
feature_flags.delete_when: the new path is permanent -- drop the field and the branch together

foreign_branches.main: pristine mirror of upstream restatedev/restate. Only ever fast-forwarded from `upstream`. Never commit to it, never open a leaf from it, never push it to origin as if it were ours.

notes.fork: origin = git@github.com:logunovFGP/restate-windows (SSH, personal key). upstream = https://github.com/restatedev/restate.git (read-only; fetch main from here).
notes.ci: ci.yml does NOT run on push to windows-support -- it triggers on pull_request, workflow_dispatch, and push to main/release-*. A push to trunk therefore triggers nothing on this fork; the local verify_command is the only gate. Open a PR to get CI.
notes.verify_cost: `just verify` = check-fmt + clippy + check-deny + nextest + doctest over the whole workspace. That cannot run on Windows: it pulls in restate-ingress-kafka (rdkafka -> krb5-src). verify_command therefore points at `just verify-platform`, which dispatches to `just windows-verify` (fmt + scoped clippy + scoped nextest + both hakari gates + the jemalloc dependency guard) on Windows and to `just verify` elsewhere. Narrow this field further if needed; never reach for --no-verify.
notes.line_endings: governed by .gitattributes + .editorconfig; see the `chore: declare line endings` commit. Never mix a renormalize with a logic change.
notes.verify_prerequisites: SATISFIED on this workstation as of 2026-09-20: rustup 1.92.0 + MSVC Build Tools 2022, protoc (Google.Protobuf) and LLVM/libclang installed, and just, cargo-nextest, cargo-deny and cargo-hakari all present. Build scripts need PROTOC and LIBCLANG_PATH exported when cargo is invoked outside a shell that has them on PATH.
